DIY Accounting Submit

How to file micro-entity accounts at Companies House

File your company's annual accounts online from your own figures

Submit turns the figures you give it into micro-entity accounts and files them with Companies House. You choose the accounting period, enter the balance sheet and profit and loss figures, check the answers and file.

File micro-entity accounts

What you need before you start

  • Your company number.
  • The accounting period and the balance sheet and profit and loss figures for it.
  • The name of the director who approves the balance sheet, and the date of approval.
  • A Google or Microsoft account to sign in to Submit.

The steps

  1. Find the company

    Open File Micro-entity Accounts to find the company.

  2. Enter the company number

    Type the company number.

  3. Look up the company

    Look up the company with Companies House.

  4. Confirm the company name

    Companies House confirms the company name.

  5. Set the accounting period

    Set the accounting period.

  6. This year, then last year

    Enter this year's balance sheet, then last year's for comparison.

  7. Net assets must balance

    This checks net assets against capital and reserves.

  8. Name the approving director

    Name the director approving the accounts.

  9. Accept the statements

    Accept the four statutory statements.

  10. Preview

    Preview the iXBRL before anything is filed. These are the accounts as they will be filed. Nothing has gone to Companies House yet.

  11. File it

    Type the company's Companies House authentication code. Filing costs one token. Submit the filing to Companies House.

  12. Companies House checks it

    The filing goes to Companies House.

  13. Companies House has the filing

    Companies House has the filing and reports the outcome here.

  14. Open your copy

    Open your copy of the filing.

  15. The filed accounts

    Your copy shows the filed accounts, the submission number and the status.

  16. Kept on your receipts

    Your copy stays on your receipts page.

Price

The Resident Ltd bundle covers this filing and costs £9.99 a year or £0.99 a month.

When it is due

A private limited company files its annual accounts with Companies House within 9 months of the end of its financial year.

File annual accounts with Companies House 9 months after your company’s financial year ends
